resources.name: Channel Divinity
resources.note: Cleric 2, Paladin 3. A shared pool: Turn Undead, Turn Undead (Paladin) and Preserve Life all spend it. Paladin uses a spell slot instead, so the cost entry is a cost alternative rather than this pool.

resources.name: Ki
resources.note: Monk 2. A shared pool spent by Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, Step of the Wind and Stunning Strike.

resources.name: Sorcery Points
resources.note: Sorcerer 2. Gained by casting spells, spent on Metamagic and Flexible Casting. Accumulates rather than refilling on a rest.

resources.name: Bardic Inspiration
resources.note: Bard 2. Recharges dice on a long rest rather than restoring a flat count; the die size is a feature tier, not a resource field.

resources.name: Wild Shape Uses
resources.note: Druid 2. Limits Wild Shape itself, which is why Wild Shape does not also carry a limit.

resources.name: Lay on Hands Pools
resources.note: Paladin 1. A pool of hit points, not charges, so the amount a feature spends is chosen by the player.

resources.name: Hit Dice
resources.note: One per character level. Spent by Short Rest recovery and regained on a long rest.

resources.name: Spell Slots
resources.note: Tracked per spell level on the character sheet. Created by Arcane Recovery and by Sorcery Point conversion.

resources.name: Superiority Dice
resources.note: Ranger 3. Recharges on a long rest.

resources.name: Luck Points
resources.note: Not granted by a class. The Lucky feat provides it, and a character without that feat has none, so the cost resolves to 0 available.
